newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Banking Corp allots $50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Allied Banking Corp allots $50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Allied Banking Corp's US$50 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 2000 has been allotted, arranger Standard Chartered Bank said Tuesday.
The three-year certificates were priced at par to float at 75 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 82 basis points.
Arrangers are ABN Amro Hoare Govett and Fuji International Finance (HK), with US$6 million each, and Standard Chartered Bank, with US$7 million.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Bank of Taiwan's Singapore branch, Bayerische Landesbank's Singapore branch and KeyBank.

Senior managers are Baden-Wurttembergische Bank, Bank Austria's Singapore branch, Berliner Bank and Dah Ah Commercial Bank, with US$3 million each, and Comerica Bank and First Commercial Bank's Hong Kong branch, with US$2 million each.
Signing is set for April 18. The payment date is on April 25.
